div.div:
Recovery design (ADR-0001)
If us-east-1 or the AWS account is lost, production fails over to AKS through health-checked DNS failover. The mode is active-passive.
Dual-provider DNS. The registrar delegates microtodosuite.online to both Route 53 and Azure DNS, and Terraform keeps both record sets identical, so failover does not depend on the AWS account surviving.
What is copied here in advance: every production image by digest, the four production secrets, Terraform state replicas, and Velero backups of eco.
RPO: zero for mirrored images and secrets; the last backup for eco; in-memory application data is lost.
RTO: minutes — scale the warm standby and fail DNS over.
eco is restored from its backups rather than failed over; fdev and fstg wait for the region. Active-active latency routing is excluded until a replicated data store exists.
